title: graellsia hederifolia subsp. cossonii
intro: Graellsia hederifolia subsp. cossonii, commonly known as the Cosson's fern, is a species of fern belonging to the Blechnaceae family. It is traditionally used in folk medicine due to its numerous health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Graellsia hederifolia subsp. cossonii are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of various conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
